purpose: Human semantic definition for every property exposed by the Bangladesh Procurement v2 machine write contract.

root.argus_id.definition: Permanent ARGUS identifier for this PROCUREMENT process/cycle.
root.argus_id.when_populated: Always for a canonical v2 procurement payload.
root.argus_id.not_to_confuse_with: External tender, package, project, award or contract identifiers.

root.requirement_ref.definition: Stable reference to the underlying commercial or mission need shared across procurement cycles.
root.requirement_ref.when_populated: When underlying requirement lineage is reconciled.
root.requirement_ref.not_to_confuse_with: The procurement process ID or project ID.

root.title.definition: Normalized human-readable title of this procurement cycle.
root.title.when_populated: Always once a reliable title or item description is available.
root.title.not_to_confuse_with: Project title, notice title or lot title.

root.description.definition: Concise normalized description of procurement scope beyond the title.
root.description.when_populated: When scope needs clarification beyond the title.
root.description.not_to_confuse_with: Raw source wording retained in observations.

root.record_state.definition: State of the ARGUS data record itself, such as current, candidate, superseded or archived.
root.record_state.not_to_confuse_with: Procurement process, contract or implementation status.

root.record_revision.definition: Monotonic revision number of this ARGUS record.
root.record_revision.not_to_confuse_with: Notice version, corrigendum number or re-tender sequence.

root.identifiers.definition: Collection of typed external identifiers attached to this procurement or its scoped planning context.
root.identifiers.when_populated: Whenever a source publishes a typed identifier relevant to the procurement.
root.identifiers.not_to_confuse_with: Untyped aliases or linked PROJECT identifiers stored on PROJECT context.

root.related_record_refs.definition: Links to canonical records such as PROJECT, ENTITY, OPPORTUNITY, INTELLIGENCE, KNOWLEDGE or SUPPLIER_PRODUCT.
root.related_record_refs.when_populated: When reconciliation establishes a relationship to another canonical record.
root.related_record_refs.not_to_confuse_with: Copying the linked record's attributes into PROCUREMENT.

root.party_role_links.definition: Links canonical parties to their functional roles in this procurement.
root.party_role_links.when_populated: When institutional, buyer, end-user, funder or supplier roles are evidenced.
root.party_role_links.not_to_confuse_with: Government hierarchy, which belongs on ENTITY relationships.

root.budget.when_populated: When a source provides procurement-specific budget facts.
root.budget.not_to_confuse_with: Financing source/instrument, project total cost or procurement estimate.

root.financing_entries.definition: Structured financing sources or instruments applicable to the procurement or linked scope.
root.financing_entries.when_populated: When government, loan, credit, grant, own-fund, G2G or other financing is evidenced.

root.process.definition: Procurement-process controls such as route, category, selection method, market scope, configuration and status.
root.process.when_populated: When one or more process controls are known.
root.process.not_to_confuse_with: Notice publication metadata or contract execution.

root.lots.definition: Separately identifiable lots within one procurement process.
root.lots.not_to_confuse_with: Packages, items or separate procurement cycles.

root.items.definition: Goods, works or service line items being acquired.
root.items.when_populated: When one or more procurement items can be identified.

root.notices.definition: Actual publications about the procurement process.
root.notices.when_populated: When a tender notice, corrigendum, addendum or other publication is observed.
root.notices.not_to_confuse_with: The procurement process itself or a planned publication milestone.

root.milestones.definition: Typed planned, scheduled or achieved lifecycle dates.
root.milestones.when_populated: When material procurement dates are evidenced.
root.milestones.not_to_confuse_with: Events that change dates or notices that publish information.

root.events.definition: Append-only lifecycle occurrences or changes such as extensions, cancellation, reissue, award or signing.
root.events.when_populated: When an event is supported by evidence at the appropriate claim level.

root.requirements.definition: Typed bidder, supplier, product, legal, technical or participation requirements.
root.requirements.when_populated: When material requirements are published or otherwise supported.
root.requirements.not_to_confuse_with: The underlying mission/commercial requirement referenced by requirement_ref.

root.fees.definition: Typed participation charges such as tender-document or schedule-purchase fees.

root.securities.definition: Typed financial guarantees such as tender security or performance security.
root.securities.when_populated: When a security or guarantee is required.

root.contacts.definition: Purpose-specific procurement contact points linked where possible to canonical parties.
root.contacts.when_populated: When source contact information is published or otherwise evidenced.
root.contacts.not_to_confuse_with: Permanent organization master data unless the same contact is authoritative there.

root.awards.definition: Award-decision objects linking selected suppliers, lots/items and award value.
root.awards.when_populated: After an award decision is evidenced.

root.contracts.definition: Signed or otherwise legally established contract objects resulting from awards.

root.implementation.definition: Contract-execution and delivery state after contract formation.
root.implementation.when_populated: During or after contract execution when implementation evidence exists.

root.observations.definition: Field-level provenance preserving source labels, raw values, evidence type and freshness.
root.observations.when_populated: For material canonical values and relevant source-only facts.
root.observations.not_to_confuse_with: Canonical values themselves or free-form notes.

root.intelligence.definition: ARGUS commercial/opportunity intelligence attached to the procurement context.
root.intelligence.when_populated: When ARGUS assesses maturity, supplier discovery, unknowns or next action.
root.intelligence.not_to_confuse_with: Official procurement facts or source-reported process status.

typed_identifier.scheme.definition: Semantic type of an identifier, for example SYSTEM_TENDER_ID, TENDER_REFERENCE_NO, PACKAGE_NO or DGDP_TENDER_NUMBER.
typed_identifier.scheme.not_to_confuse_with: The source's display label or identifier value.

typed_identifier.value.definition: Exact identifier value preserved as text.
typed_identifier.value.not_to_confuse_with: Numeric meaning; identifiers remain strings even when digits-only.

typed_identifier.scope.definition: Lifecycle or object scope identified by the identifier, such as PROCESS, PLAN, PACKAGE, LOT or CONTRACT.

typed_identifier.source_system.definition: Source system from which the identifier was obtained.
typed_identifier.source_system.not_to_confuse_with: The organization that issued the identifier.

typed_identifier.source_label.definition: Exact or faithful source label used for the identifier field.
typed_identifier.source_label.when_populated: When the source label is available.

related_record_ref.argus_id.definition: ARGUS identifier of the linked canonical record.

related_record_ref.relation_type.definition: Semantic relationship from this procurement to the linked record.

party_role_link.party_id.definition: Canonical ENTITY identifier of the party participating in the procurement.
party_role_link.party_id.not_to_confuse_with: PE code, project code or source organization ID.

party_role_link.role.definition: Functional role performed by the linked party in this procurement.
party_role_link.role.not_to_confuse_with: Organization type, hierarchy or job title.

party_role_link.source_role_label.definition: Source wording that described the party's role.
party_role_link.source_role_label.when_populated: When the source labels the role.

party_role_link.unit_label.definition: Source-published operational wing, section, cell or unit below a canonical party when a separate ENTITY is not justified.
party_role_link.unit_label.when_populated: When a source names a sub-unit such as Navy Wing / NP-8.
party_role_link.unit_label.not_to_confuse_with: The identity of the procuring organization itself.

party_role_link.effective_from.definition: Date/time from which this party-role assignment is known to apply.
party_role_link.effective_from.when_populated: When the effective start is evidenced.

party_role_link.effective_to.definition: Date/time through which this party-role assignment is known to apply.
party_role_link.effective_to.when_populated: When the role's end is evidenced.

budget.type.definition: Bangladesh budget classification applying to the procurement, such as Development or Revenue.
budget.type.when_populated: When the source states the budget type.

budget.fiscal_year.definition: Fiscal year of the procurement-specific budget allocation.
budget.fiscal_year.when_populated: When the budget allocation is tied to a fiscal year.
budget.fiscal_year.not_to_confuse_with: APP fiscal year or project implementation period.

budget.amount.definition: Amount specifically allocated in the applicable budget to this procurement.
budget.amount.when_populated: Only when a procurement-specific allocation is evidenced.
budget.amount.not_to_confuse_with: Project total cost, procurement estimate, award value or contract value.

budget.line_reference.definition: Budget line, economic code or allocation reference tied to this procurement.
budget.line_reference.not_to_confuse_with: APP ID, package number or project code.

financing.source_party_id.definition: Canonical party supplying the financing, such as GoB, World Bank, ADB, JICA or AIIB.
financing.source_party_id.not_to_confuse_with: Buyer, implementing agency or procuring entity.

financing.instrument.definition: Legal/economic financing form such as government allocation, loan, credit, grant, own fund or G2G.

financing.reference.definition: Loan, credit, grant or financing-agreement reference.
financing.reference.when_populated: When a financing reference is published.
financing.reference.not_to_confuse_with: Project ID, tender reference or package number.

financing.amount.definition: Amount contributed by this financing entry.
financing.amount.not_to_confuse_with: Total project, procurement, award or contract value.

financing.currency.not_to_confuse_with: Contract currency or tender currency basis.

financing.commitment_date.definition: Date the financing commitment/agreement became formally committed when evidenced.
financing.commitment_date.when_populated: When an authoritative source states it.

financing.status.definition: Current lifecycle state of the financing entry, such as proposed, approved, signed, effective or disbursing.

financing.conditions.definition: Financing-linked conditions such as source-country, tied/untied or eligible-country restrictions.
financing.conditions.when_populated: When conditions are stated by the financing evidence.

financing.scope.definition: Scope to which this financing entry applies, such as procurement, project or lot.
financing.scope.when_populated: When scope needs to be distinguished.
financing.scope.not_to_confuse_with: Identifier scope or market competition scope.

process.route.definition: ARGUS Bangladesh acquisition-route classification, such as general e-GP, DGDP or development-partner route.

process.category.definition: Top-level nature of what is procured: goods, works, consulting services or non-consulting services.
process.category.not_to_confuse_with: Selection method, market scope or product taxonomy.

process.method_normalized.definition: Internationally normalized supplier-selection method, such as open, selective, limited or direct selection.
process.method_normalized.when_populated: When the source selection method is known and safely normalized.
process.method_normalized.not_to_confuse_with: OTM/LTM source code, NCT/ICT market scope or envelope configuration.

process.method_source_code.definition: Exact source method code such as OTM, LTM, RFQ or DPM.
process.method_source_code.when_populated: When the source publishes a method code.

process.method_source_label.definition: Exact or faithful source label for the procurement selection method.
process.method_source_label.not_to_confuse_with: Normalized selection method or process configuration.

process.competition_scope.definition: Market scope of competition, for example NATIONAL, INTERNATIONAL or financing-restricted competition.
process.competition_scope.when_populated: When NCT/ICT or equivalent market scope is explicitly evidenced.
process.competition_scope.not_to_confuse_with: Selection method, currency basis or stage/envelope configuration.

process.configuration.definition: Procedural stage/envelope structure, such as one-stage two-envelope or two-stage.
process.configuration.when_populated: When explicitly stated or safely normalized.

process.review_type.definition: Financier review/control classification such as prior or post review.
process.review_type.when_populated: When a financier or authoritative plan states it.
process.review_type.not_to_confuse_with: Approval status, selection method or audit review.

process.prequalification_required.definition: Whether formal prequalification or preselection is required before bidding.
process.prequalification_required.not_to_confuse_with: General bidder eligibility or experience criteria.

process.framework_agreement.definition: Whether the procurement establishes or uses a framework agreement.
process.framework_agreement.not_to_confuse_with: Multi-lot procurement or a long-term contract.

process.status_raw.not_to_confuse_with: ARGUS record state or normalized process status.

process.status_normalized.definition: ARGUS normalized procurement-process status derived only when supported.
process.status_normalized.when_populated: When source evidence supports safe normalization.
process.status_normalized.not_to_confuse_with: Record, project, award, contract or implementation status.

process.estimated_value.definition: Pre-award estimated value of the procurement process/package.
process.estimated_value.when_populated: When an authoritative estimate is available.
process.estimated_value.not_to_confuse_with: Budget allocation, award value or contract value.

process.currency.not_to_confuse_with: Tender currency basis or contract currency.

lot.lot_id.definition: Identity of a lot within the procurement process.
lot.lot_id.not_to_confuse_with: Package number, process ID or lot reference.

lot.lot_reference.definition: Additional published lot code or identification distinct from lot_id when applicable.

lot.description.definition: Additional scope description specific to a lot.

lot.estimated_value.definition: Pre-award estimated value specific to this lot.
lot.estimated_value.not_to_confuse_with: Process total, award or contract value.

lot.delivery_location.definition: Delivery or performance location specific to this lot.

classification.scheme.definition: Taxonomy/classification scheme used for an item, such as UNSPSC or CPV.

classification.id.definition: Code assigned to the item under the stated classification scheme.

classification.description.definition: Human-readable description associated with the classification code.
classification.description.when_populated: When available from the source or governed taxonomy.

item.item_id.definition: Stable identity of an item row inside this procurement payload.
item.item_id.not_to_confuse_with: Product taxonomy code or lot ID.

item.description.definition: Description of the good, work or service item being acquired.
item.description.not_to_confuse_with: Process title, lot title or product master record.

item.quantity.definition: Numeric quantity of the item when meaningful.
item.quantity.when_populated: When the source states or supports a quantity.
item.quantity.not_to_confuse_with: Number of lots or package count.

item.unit.definition: Unit of measure applying to item.quantity.
item.unit.when_populated: When a unit is stated or unambiguous.

item.lot_ref.definition: Reference from an item to its containing lot.
item.lot_ref.when_populated: When the procurement has lot structure.
item.lot_ref.not_to_confuse_with: Lot reference value from the source.

item.classifications.definition: Typed taxonomy classifications attached to the item.
item.classifications.when_populated: When source or governed taxonomy classifications are available.

notice.notice_id.definition: Identity of a particular notice publication.
notice.notice_id.when_populated: When the publication system exposes a notice identifier.

notice.notice_type.definition: Semantic type of actual publication, such as tender notice, corrigendum or public mirror notice.

notice.version.definition: Version/revision of the same notice publication when the source supports versioning.
notice.version.not_to_confuse_with: ARGUS record revision or re-tender cycle.

notice.published_at.definition: Actual date/time the notice was published or became publicly available.
notice.published_at.when_populated: When actual publication time is evidenced.

notice.source_system.definition: Portal, publication system or source family that issued or exposed the notice.

notice.source_locator.definition: URL, file or other locator where the notice can be retrieved or identified.
notice.source_locator.not_to_confuse_with: Bid submission channel or physical address.

milestone.milestone_id.definition: Stable identity of a procurement lifecycle milestone entry.

milestone.type.definition: Meaning of the planned, scheduled or achieved lifecycle point, including document readiness, expected publication, submission, opening, evaluation, signing or completion.
milestone.type.not_to_confuse_with: Notice type or lifecycle event type.

milestone.due_at.definition: Current authoritative planned/scheduled due date or time for the milestone.
milestone.due_at.not_to_confuse_with: Original due date or actual date met.

milestone.original_due_at.definition: First authoritative due date before any extensions or changes.
milestone.original_due_at.when_populated: When initial schedule history is known and material.

milestone.date_modified.definition: Date/time the milestone schedule was officially modified.
milestone.date_modified.when_populated: When a schedule change is evidenced.
milestone.date_modified.not_to_confuse_with: The new due date or notice publication date unless identical by evidence.

milestone.status.definition: State of the milestone, such as planned, scheduled, met, missed or cancelled.

milestone.lot_ref.definition: Lot to which the milestone applies when scoped below process level.
milestone.lot_ref.not_to_confuse_with: Lot ID as an external identifier.

milestone.source_ref.definition: Reference to the notice/evidence object supporting this milestone.
milestone.source_ref.when_populated: When a supporting source reference is available.
milestone.source_ref.not_to_confuse_with: Source URL itself unless used as the chosen reference.

change.field.definition: Canonical field or milestone concept changed by a lifecycle event.

change.previous_value.definition: Value in force immediately before the event change; may be any JSON value.
change.previous_value.not_to_confuse_with: Original-ever value if intermediate changes occurred.

change.new_value.definition: Value made effective by the event change; may be any JSON value.

event.event_id.definition: Stable identity of an append-only procurement lifecycle event.

event.type.definition: Semantic type of lifecycle occurrence, such as deadline extension, cancellation, reissue, award or contract signing.

event.occurred_at.definition: Date/time the event occurred or took effect.
event.occurred_at.when_populated: When the occurrence/effective date is evidenced.

event.notice_ref.definition: Reference to a notice that published or documented the event.

event.reason_raw.definition: Exact or faithful source-stated reason for the event.
event.reason_raw.when_populated: Only when the source states a reason.
event.reason_raw.not_to_confuse_with: ARGUS inference about why the event occurred.

event.changes.definition: Structured previous/new-value changes caused by the event.
event.changes.when_populated: When specific changed values can be represented.

event.source_ref.definition: Reference to the evidence supporting the event.
event.source_ref.when_populated: When a supporting source reference is available.
event.source_ref.not_to_confuse_with: Notice reference when no notice exists.

requirement.requirement_id.definition: Stable identity of one structured participation/qualification/technical requirement.

requirement.type.definition: Semantic category of the requirement, such as enlistment, experience, financial capacity or OEM authorization.

requirement.text.definition: Source-grounded wording or faithful summary of the requirement.

requirement.normalized_value.definition: Machine-usable normalized value extracted from requirement text; may be any JSON value.

requirement.mandatory.definition: Whether the source makes this requirement mandatory.

requirement.scope.definition: Process, lot, item or other scope to which the requirement applies.

requirement.lot_ref.definition: Lot to which the requirement applies when lot-specific.
requirement.lot_ref.not_to_confuse_with: Lot reference published by the source.

requirement.source_ref.definition: Reference to evidence supporting the requirement.
requirement.source_ref.when_populated: When a supporting source reference is available.

fee.fee_id.definition: Stable identity of one procurement fee entry.
fee.fee_id.not_to_confuse_with: Security ID or payment transaction ID.

fee.type.definition: Type of procurement fee, such as tender-document or schedule-purchase charge.

fee.amount.when_populated: When amount can be reliably parsed.

fee.raw_text.definition: Exact or faithful source expression for the fee.
fee.raw_text.when_populated: When source wording is useful for auditability.

fee.refundable.when_populated: When explicitly stated or directly supported.

fee.lot_ref.definition: Lot to which the fee applies when lot-specific.

fee.source_ref.definition: Reference to evidence supporting the fee.
fee.source_ref.when_populated: When a supporting source reference is available.

security.security_id.definition: Stable identity of one security/guarantee obligation.
security.security_id.not_to_confuse_with: Fee ID or bank guarantee number unless separately modeled as evidence.

security.type.definition: Type of financial security, such as tender security, performance security or advance-payment guarantee.

security.amount.definition: Numeric amount of the required security when unambiguous.

security.raw_text.definition: Exact or faithful source expression for the security requirement.
security.raw_text.when_populated: When source wording is useful for auditability.

security.validity_until.definition: Date/time through which the security must remain valid.

security.lot_ref.definition: Lot to which the security applies when lot-specific.

security.source_ref.definition: Reference to evidence supporting the security obligation.
security.source_ref.when_populated: When a supporting source reference is available.

contact_point.contact_id.definition: Stable identity of a purpose-specific procurement contact entry.
contact_point.contact_id.not_to_confuse_with: Person ENTITY ID unless the contact is separately canonicalized.

contact_point.party_id.definition: Canonical party with which the contact point is associated.
contact_point.party_id.when_populated: When the contact belongs to a known ENTITY.

contact_point.purpose.definition: Operational purpose of the contact, such as clarification, procurement office or submission support.

contact_point.name.definition: Name of the published contact person when available.

contact_point.designation.definition: Published job title or designation of the contact person.

contact_point.address.definition: Published postal/physical address for the contact purpose.

contact_point.email.definition: Published email address for the contact purpose.
contact_point.email.not_to_confuse_with: Organization-wide email unless it is the stated contact.

contact_point.phone.definition: Published telephone number for the contact purpose.
contact_point.phone.not_to_confuse_with: Fax or other communication channel unless encoded in the same source value.

contact_point.source_ref.definition: Reference to evidence supporting the contact details.
contact_point.source_ref.when_populated: When a supporting source reference is available.

award.award_id.definition: Stable identity of an award decision object.

award.award_date.definition: Date/time of the award decision or notice of award when evidenced.

award.supplier_party_ids.definition: Canonical ENTITY IDs of suppliers selected by this award.

award.lot_refs.definition: Lots covered by this award decision.

award.value.definition: Monetary value of the award decision.
award.value.not_to_confuse_with: Contract signed value or current amended implementation value.

award.approval_reference.definition: Approval, NOA or decision reference associated with the award.

award.financing.definition: Financing entries specifically applicable to this award when they differ from or refine process-level financing.

contract.contract_id.definition: Stable ARGUS identity of a contract object.

contract.contract_number.definition: Official reference/number of the signed legal contract.
contract.contract_number.when_populated: When the signed contract or authoritative source provides it.
contract.contract_number.not_to_confuse_with: Tender reference, award ID or procurement process ID.

contract.award_ref.definition: Reference to the award decision from which this contract results.
contract.award_ref.when_populated: When an award object is linked.

contract.supplier_party_ids.definition: Canonical ENTITY IDs of suppliers/contractors party to the contract.

contract.value.definition: Monetary value of the contract at signing or as the authoritative contract value for this object.
contract.value.not_to_confuse_with: Award value or current amended implementation value.

contract.signed_at.definition: Date/time the legal contract was signed.
contract.signed_at.not_to_confuse_with: Award date or planned contract-signing milestone.

contract.period_start.definition: Contractual start date of the performance period.
contract.period_start.when_populated: When stated in authoritative contract data.
contract.period_start.not_to_confuse_with: Procurement publication or project start date.

contract.period_end.definition: Contractual end date of the performance period.
contract.period_end.when_populated: When stated or contractually calculable and supported.

contract.status.definition: Current legal/administrative status of the contract.
contract.status.when_populated: When authoritative contract status is available.

implementation.status.when_populated: During or after contract performance when status is evidenced.
implementation.status.not_to_confuse_with: Contract legal status or project implementation status.

implementation.progress_pct.definition: Reported percentage progress of contract delivery/execution.

implementation.actual_completion_date.definition: Actual date contract performance was completed.
implementation.actual_completion_date.not_to_confuse_with: Planned completion milestone or contract period end.

implementation.current_value.definition: Current contract value after approved modifications when such a current value is evidenced.

implementation.milestones.definition: Contract-implementation milestones distinct from procurement-stage milestones.

implementation.transactions.definition: Execution-stage financial/payment transactions retained as structured source-derived objects.
implementation.transactions.when_populated: When transaction-level implementation data is available.

implementation.modifications.definition: Approved contract modifications/variations retained as structured implementation objects.
implementation.modifications.when_populated: When contract amendments or variations are evidenced.

observation.observation_id.definition: Stable identity of one field-level provenance observation.
observation.observation_id.not_to_confuse_with: Source record ID or canonical field path.

observation.field_path.definition: Canonical or source-only field/concept supported by the observation.

observation.value.definition: Normalized value supported by the observation; may be any JSON value.
observation.value.when_populated: When the observation supports a value.

observation.raw_label.definition: Exact source field, heading or column label associated with the observation.

observation.raw_value.definition: Exact source representation before normalization; may be any JSON value.
observation.raw_value.when_populated: When the source exposes a value.

observation.source_id.definition: Identifier of the source record, notice, file or source object supporting the observation.
observation.source_id.when_populated: When the source has an identifier.

observation.source_system.definition: Source system or publication family from which the observation was obtained.

observation.source_locator.definition: URL, file, page, row, section or other locator supporting the observation.

observation.observed_at.definition: Date/time ARGUS observed, retrieved or received the evidence.

observation.published_at.definition: Date/time the source published the information when known.
observation.published_at.when_populated: When source publication timing is available.
observation.published_at.not_to_confuse_with: ARGUS observed_at or expected publication milestone.

observation.claim_type.definition: ARGUS evidence type: FACT, DERIVED, INFERENCE, ASSUMPTION or UNKNOWN.

observation.condition.definition: Freshness/conflict condition: CURRENT, STALE, CONFLICT or UNKNOWN.

observation.assurance.definition: ATLAS evidence-assurance classification when ATLAS-governed execution provides one.

intelligence.maturity.definition: ARGUS opportunity-development maturity classification I0 through I9.

intelligence.activation_mode.definition: Commercial activation mode: early requirement development, planned procurement capture or live tender response.
intelligence.activation_mode.when_populated: When ARGUS classifies how Access Asia should engage the opportunity.

intelligence.commercial_fit.definition: Structured or scalar ARGUS assessment of commercial relevance/fit; may be any JSON value.
intelligence.commercial_fit.not_to_confuse_with: Technical compliance, eligibility or official evaluation result.

intelligence.supplier_discovery_state.definition: Current state of supplier/OEM discovery and qualification work.
intelligence.supplier_discovery_state.not_to_confuse_with: Procurement status or supplier award status.

intelligence.material_unknowns.definition: Unresolved facts likely to change the next commercial/intelligence decision or action.
intelligence.material_unknowns.not_to_confuse_with: General notes or low-value missing fields.

intelligence.research_frontier.definition: Highest-decision-value unresolved research question at the current stage.
intelligence.research_frontier.when_populated: When further research could materially change action.

intelligence.next_action.definition: Recommended next ARGUS research/commercial action based on current evidence.
intelligence.next_action.when_populated: When the record supports a concrete next action.
intelligence.next_action.not_to_confuse_with: Action by the procuring authority or a guaranteed future event.
